description: Capture one pick with the person's own note. Omit `list` only to deliberately use Inbox. An ambiguous or missing list writes nothing and returns candidates; ask the person, or set `create_if_missing` when they explicitly want a new list. Report the returned details status exactly.

author.description: Author or creator as the person gives it (books, articles, posts), e.g. from "Title - Author - why". Stored as the pick's author and never replaced by added details. Keep it out of the note.

create_if_missing.description: When true and no list matches `list`, create that private list and save there.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Reusing it with identical input replays the first result.

list.description: List slug or title. Fuzzy-matched against the curator's lists. Omit to use Inbox.

note.description: The curator's own note on why they like or recommend this pick. Shown to readers as written and never rewritten by AI, so capture it in the curator's voice when they give a reason.

title.description: Short title for the pick (e.g. restaurant name, book title). Required when url is absent.

url.description: The URL being captured, if any.

name: add_item
title: Add a pick
